M1_one_masked_round_value_moved.what: the published masked round message of slot 00, round 0, evaluation point 0, moved by one in its real part
M1_one_masked_round_value_moved.why: the slot's system is OVERDETERMINED -- (rounds x (degree+1) + 1) Fp2 equations against L Fp2 unknowns -- and the published rounds lie in its image only because they were MADE by adding c_s g_s to an honest transcript.  Moving one entry leaves that image, and no mask coefficients reproduce it.  The round is named by re-solving with each round's equations dropped in turn

at_an_a_row.where_it_fires: NOT on the a-row itself: the a-rows carry Q = 256 pads against 248 distinct sampled nodes, so their Cauchy block is square and nonsingular and the pads absorb the moved target exactly.  It fires on the FOUR rows below -- b_re, b_im, u_re, u_im, at that one column and at no other -- because b is the residue of q and u the residue of the proximity vector: absorbing the move on the a-row moves the verifier's per-column identity at that node, and the capture's own b and u entries there contradict it.  The pads buy the a-row and pay for it four rows down

M2_one_opened_column_entry_moved.what: one entry of the opened column at position 0 (a node sampled exactly once), moved by one
M2_one_opened_column_entry_moved.why: the b and u rows are not free: b is forced by q and u by the proximity vector, so their column values are determined once the a-rows are.  A moved entry on one of them cannot be met, and a moved entry on an a-row cannot be met either -- it reappears on them

M3_declared_functional_order_permuted.what: functionals 0 and 1 of the DECLARED order swapped, so each takes the other's power of theta
M3_declared_functional_order_permuted.why: the first flavour fails b's zero sum: the permuted batch is a different functional of the same coefficients.  The second removes that excuse by forcing the coefficients onto the PERMUTED plane -- b is then admissible and the view STILL has no preimage, because the verifier's per-column identity acc = sum_s a_s(x) W_s(x) + b(x) reads the weights themselves.  The order is pinned by the columns, not only by the scalar sum

per_slot.spec_refusal_example: functional 9: 38 weights for a mask of 35 coefficients
functional 10: 38 weights for a mask of 35 coefficients

M4_a_slot_mask_length_declared_one_short.what: each of the two REPAIRED BILINEAR slots (extension rounds 2, degree 3) modelled with one coefficient fewer than CfsMask::len(n, d) gives it
M4_a_slot_mask_length_declared_one_short.why: two independent things refuse.  (a) The batched weight table does not vanish above the DECLARED length, which is the shape check `weights_vanish_above_L` -- and that check is the whole of the argument that the pads drop out of V(a).  (b) With one coefficient moved into the pad region V(a) changes and b is inadmissible.  A spec one VARIABLE short is refused a third way, by `combined_weights`'s own length assert, which is the Rust's

M5_one_coefficient_shared_between_two_sl.what: one mask coefficient of slot 08 and the coefficient at the same index of slot 09 declared to be ONE unknown (synthetic: the honest layout shares none).  Two coordinates are used, and which is which is COMPUTED from the two slots' kernels
M5_one_coefficient_shared_between_two_sl.what_it_discloses: M's OWN disclosed dimension does not move: it is one Fp2 functional of whatever unknown space there is, so identifying two coordinates leaves it at 2 Fp while the unknown space and the fibre each lose exactly 2 Fp.  The disclosure that moves is on the CFS side, and only at a coordinate the two slots' rounds each FORCE: there the shared unknown must take two different values at once and there is no joint solution.  That is the masking layer's form of round 7's control P-5 -- per-slot solutions exist and a joint one does not -- and it is why 'per commitment' and 'per slot' are not the same word as 'per run'
M5_one_coefficient_shared_between_two_sl.why: at a FREE coordinate each slot has a whole Fp2 of freedom there and the identification is satisfiable, which the record says rather than hides; at a FORCED one neither has any and the two values differ, so no assignment satisfies both slots at once

M6_one_pad_fewer_than_the_distinct_opene.what: every a-row of M modelled with 247 pads against 248 distinct opened columns (the real budget is 256, margin 8)
M6_one_pad_fewer_than_the_distinct_opene.why: with fewer pad symbols than distinct opened columns the a-row's message cannot meet the captured column values at every sampled node, so the view leaves the image of the blinding map.  This is the control on the side that CAN fail: at the real budget the Cauchy block is square and nonsingular and every admissible coefficient vector on the V plane has a preimage
